query:
SELECT DISTINCT r.record_cid AS "record_cid!"
            FROM records r
            WHERE r.repo_id = $1
              AND r.record_cid = ANY($2)
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST($3::text[], $4::text[]) AS k(collection, rkey)
                  WHERE k.collection = r.collection AND k.rkey = r.rkey
              )
